fields.description: Unique name for this physical label layout, e.g. `Digi-Reel`, `Mouser Reel`, `Generic Manufacturer`.
fields.label: Layout Name

fields.description: A representative photo of this label, rectified (deskewed, cropped to the label edge). Field regions below are drawn against this image.
fields.label: Sample Image

fields.description: Pixel width of the reference sample. Regions are stored as fractions (0–1), so this is informational for the editor.
fields.label: Reference Width (px)

fields.description: Newline-separated text anchors that must appear in the OCR'd label for this layout to match. The layout with the most anchor hits wins; ties break on region count.
fields.label: Match Anchors

fields.description: Number of barcodes expected on this label. Used by the browser auto-capture gate as a readiness signal; 0 disables the barcode check.
fields.label: Expected Barcodes

fields.description: One row per field to extract, with its bounding box (as fractions of the rectified image) and whether it's read as OCR text or a decoded barcode.
fields.label: Field Regions
